query: user-centric agents co-evolve environment and user simulator
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The exact match. It proposes jointly adapting the agent, user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during training.  
   **People:** Min Cai (University of Alberta); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent); Xi Ye (University of Alberta and Amii).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — Closely related training framework pairing user-centric gym environments with simulated users and studying how simulator choice and reward design affect learning.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), plus Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736)

3. **UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents** — A benchmark and training environment where simulated users progressively reveal implicit preferences during multi-turn, tool-assisted interactions.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC), Heng Ji (UIUC), plus Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Zhiwei Liu, Jianguo Zhang, Haolin Chen, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   **URL:** [arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.22034)

4. **Proactive Agent Research Environment: Simulating Active Users to Evaluate Proactive Assistants** — Introduces Pare, which represents applications as stateful environments and supports active user simulation for evaluating proactive agents.  
   **People:** Deepak Nathani, Chang Huan, Jiaming Shan, William Yang Wang, and Xin Eric Wang (UC Santa Barbara); Cheng Zhang (independent); Michael Saxon (University of Washington); Yinfei Yang (work performed at Apple); Alkesh Patel and Zhe Gan (Apple).  
   **URL:** [Apple Machine Learning Research](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/proactive-agent-research-environment)

query: meta-agent modifies training environment during multi-turn reinforcement learning
adaptive user simulator reward design LLM agents
text:
1. **EAU: Environment–Agent–User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The closest match: a meta-agent dynamically modifies the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration during training. People: Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Ye also Amii), Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore), Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology), and Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Training Proactive and Personalized LLM Agents** — Introduces UserVille and a multi-objective reward combining task success, interaction quality/user effort, and preference adherence. People: Weiwei Sun, Xuhui Zhou, Weihua Du, Sean Welleck, Maarten Sap, and Yiming Yang (Carnegie Mellon University); Xingyao Wang (OpenHands); Graham Neubig (CMU and OpenHands). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02208)

3. **Learning User Simulators with Turing Rewards** — Trains user simulators using an LLM-judge reward based on whether generated replies are indistinguishable from a real user’s responses, rather than simple response similarity. People: Yingshan Susan Wang, Cedegao E. Zhang, Linlu Qiu, Alex Pentland, Roger P. Levy, and Yoon Kim (MIT); Zexue He (Stanford); Pengyuan Li (MIT–IBM Watson AI Lab); Pentland also lists Stanford. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.19336)

4. **UserLM-R1: Modeling Human Reasoning in User Language Models with Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning** — Builds adaptive user profiles with dynamic goals, then applies rule- and rubric-based rewards for consistency, reasoning quality, alignment, and strategic behavior. People: Feng Zhang, Shijia Li, Chunmao Zhang, Zhanyu Ma, Jun Xu, Jiuchong Gao, Jinghua Hao, Renqing He, Jingwen Xu, and Han Liu; affiliations listed include Meituan, Peking University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, and Dalian University of Technology. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09215)
